# Vendored: unpdf

`unpdf.mjs` is a `bun build --bundle` of [unpdf](https://github.com/unjs/unpdf) v1.8 (MIT © UnJS), which itself bundles a serverless build of Mozilla's [pdf.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) (Apache-2.0). Vendored so PDF extraction (authoring-time) has zero npm dependencies.
